name: Teen Intern Program
what_you_do: A year-long internship at the museum. Teens do a spring training program and then work at the museum during the next school year.
pay_detail: Interns get a stipend. The amount is not stated.
duration: Spring training, then the 2026 to 27 school year
deadline_text: The 2026 round closed in March 2026. The page shows two dates, March 23 and March 16, so confirm. Next round is not posted.
how_to_apply: Send the application form. Add one letter from a teacher, coach, counselor, boss or camp counselor. A committee reads them. Only some applicants get an interview. Call 212-423-3254 with questions.
notes: Because there is a stipend, ask the museum about working papers for under 18. The page does not say. Check the museum site for the next call.
